data.body:
[P2] Bind fence deletion to the acquired ownership record

The ownership read and unconditional deletion are separate operations. If deletion succeeds but its response is lost, another harness can acquire the target before botocore retries; the retry then deletes the replacement fence. Reacquisitions with the same run and commit are also indistinguishable. This can leave active work without quarantine protection. Retain a unique acquisition identity and ETag, verify that identity on release, and delete conditionally. Add a lost-response regression that preserves a replacement fence.
